structured.reason: The description is almost entirely positive, but the "Shop With Confidence" section concedes a product weakness: "If a bottle becomes compromised or leaks during its first year, contact MoYo Natural Labs and they will replace it." This explicitly raises leaking and compromise as possible failures. That maps directly to the 1-star review about pump caps failing within two days and the other review complaints about leaks, so it falls under category 3 (defensive framing of a known complaint). The warranty is drawn from the listing's promise, but the criterion still asks for no mention of product weaknesses, explicit or implied. The "no-leak design" and "sturdy construction" claims are plain positives and do not cause the failure.
